title: The idler and the slotted slide
description: Find the instantaneous slide direction after transmission through two external meshes.
question: Drive A CCW in the front view. Find Y (horizontal travel) at the shown instant.

answer.explanation: Drive A CCW. External mesh A/I (18/22 teeth) has fixed centers. A negative, I positive. External mesh I/B (22/30 teeth) has fixed centers. I positive, B negative. The solid key makes B and K rotate together. B negative, K negative. The top crank pin sweeps right under CW drive. The slot takes the transverse component along the horizontal slide. K negative, Y negative. The requested motion is left (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: Y is left, while this choice gives right. Following the idler alone drops the second reversal between I and B.

options.label: B
options.explanation: Y is left, while this choice gives rotates. The two frame guides constrain the yoke to translation.

options.label: C
options.explanation: Y is left, while this choice gives stationary. The pin has zero vertical speed here and nonzero horizontal speed across the slot.

options.label: D
options.explanation: This tuple matches the derived motions. Two external meshes keep the keyed crank counterclockwise; its top pin travels left across the vertical slot.
